# UFMT HIFU service for uterine fibroids and adenomyosis

> A private HIFU service for uterine fibroids and adenomyosis. A programme of
> Ultra Focused Medical Technologies (UFMT), at Epiome Health Village, Melrose
> Estate, Johannesburg. Clinical care is provided by the treating clinician.

## What HIFU is

HIFU, or High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound, is a non-surgical treatment for
uterine fibroids and adenomyosis. Focused ultrasound beams pass through the
abdominal wall and converge inside the uterus, heating and destroying the target
tissue without any incision. The uterus is preserved and most patients go home
the same day.

- No cut, no scar. Nothing is cut and nothing is stitched.
- Usually no general anaesthetic. Light sedation keeps the patient comfortable.
- Home the same day. Most suitable patients are back to normal activity within
  one to three days.
- The uterus stays. The treatment targets the fibroid, not the organ.

HIFU is not experimental. In 2025 it was included in the best practice guidance
for the diagnosis and treatment of fibroids published by FIGO, the International
Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics. It is now also available to private
patients in South Africa.

## Who it is for

Women with uterine fibroids or adenomyosis, presenting with heavy bleeding,
pelvic pressure, pain, bloating or fatigue. Fibroids are common: by the age of
50, close to two thirds of women will have developed them, and among African
women the figure reaches up to 80 per cent.

HIFU is not suitable for every patient or every fibroid. Suitability is assessed
by the treating clinician after imaging, and outcomes vary between patients.

## Where

Epiome Health Village, Melrose Estate, Johannesburg, South Africa.

## Who delivers it

Clinical care and clinical advice are provided by the treating clinician, not by
UFMT. UFMT supplies and supports the HIFU technology.

## The technology

The JC300 HIFU system, supplied by UFMT.

## Important

The information on this site is general and does not constitute medical advice.
Ultra Focused Medical Technologies does not provide clinical care or clinical
advice. Treatment is delivered by qualified clinicians within the clinical
governance of the host institution.
